text: Hidden-input prompts handed to Alex (zsh `read -rs "VAR?Prompt: "` or `stty -echo; read -r`) hang on a paste longer than about 1024 bytes, because the terminal is in canonical mode; a Supabase JWT can exceed that. A subagent reproduced it in a pty on 10-16: 1000 characters worked, 1100 hung. Use `stty -echo -icanon; read -r VAR; stty sane` for long secrets, and confirm the value is set without pr…
